press_references.value: e& and Globe Forge Strategic Alliance to Enhance International Voice Traffic

partnership_announcements.description: e& and Globe announced a strategic partnership under which e& will manage Globe’s international voice traffic and serve as its preferred international voice partner. The alliance combines Globe’s Philippine market reach with e&’s carrier network, routing expertise, security tools and fraud-detection capabilities.

press_references.value: E& partners with Mrs Keepa to launch anti-cyberbullying movement

partnership_announcements.description: Telecom group e& has formed a new partnership with Dubai-based fashion label Mrs Keepa to launch CTRL + Block, a youth-focused anti-cyberbullying movement promoting digital safety and empowerment.

press_references.value: e& pumps cash into sovereign security start-up

partnership_announcements.description: e& and MagicCube formed a partnership alongside e&’s investment to collaborate on delivering sovereign-grade, hardware-free security for AI, digital identity, and payments workloads across devices and clouds.

press_references.value: e& and MEVCA announce three-year strategic partnership

partnership_announcements.description: e& and the Middle East Venture Capital Association (MEVCA) entered a three-year strategic partnership under which e& becomes MEVCA’s first corporate anchor partner and board member to jointly support the Middle East venture and innovation ecosystem.

press_references.value: E& Partners with Cisco to Upgrade EMIX Network

partnership_announcements.description: Telecom operator E& announced a new strategic partnership with Cisco Systems to upgrade its EMIX network infrastructure.

press_references.value: e& and Motorola Mobility Forge Strategic Partnership to Boost Innovation in the Middle East

partnership_announcements.description: e& and Motorola Mobility signed a strategic MoU establishing a partnership to expand Motorola’s device and services presence via e&’s regional channels and to co-develop AI-driven digital services and joint marketing in the Middle East.

press_references.value: E& and Honeywell to deliver 5G and AI-powered field solutions for businesses

partnership_announcements.description: e& UAE and Honeywell signed a Performance Partner Program Agreement to co-deliver mobile-first 5G and AI-enabled field solutions for UAE SMBs, combining e&'s 4G/5G connectivity and AI with Honeywell’s industrial hardware, automation software, and analytics.

press_references.value: E& and regional telcos unite for GCC’s first sustainability hackathon to fast-track greener networks

partnership_announcements.description: e& and leading regional telecom operators, including stc Group, Beyon, du, Ooredoo, Omantel, and Zain, have announced a partnership to launch the GCC's first Sustainability Hackathon, aiming to accelerate green technology adoption and sustainable telecom networks across the region.

press_references.value: Major Digital Infrastructure Pact: e& and 4iG Group Partner for Cross-Continental Connectivity

partnership_announcements.description: e& and 4iG Group have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding to collaborate on digital infrastructure projects, including subsea and terrestrial networks, data centres, and cross-continental connectivity between the Middle East, North Africa, and Europe.
